findings.reason: the payload directories are the bulk of the untracked data §26 cites (~7 MB, 2.4 MB in reckon), so a gate that does not force the directory to move lets the larger half of the stated defect survive a green node.
findings.text: §26's done-when records "a hold" and asserts nothing new appears under the docs directory, but the payload-directory write is made only when the request exceeds `HOLD_PAYLOAD_INLINE_LIMIT` (`_write_hold_payload`, outcomes.py:74, called at outcomes.py:246 only above the 8192-byte threshold), so a small fixture hold is stored inline and no directory is created — a node that moves `picker-holds.jsonl` to the crew home but leaves `_write_hold_payload` reading `_hold_path(docs, project).parent / HOLD_PAYLOAD_DIR` passes the gate while still writing every large payload under the project's checkout; `replay_hold` (outcomes.py:96) reads that same docs-side directory and would break for moved records

findings.reason: a node reading the clause against the real catalogue finds no such model and either skips the assertion or fabricates a catalogue without a stated basis, and the mechanism it must change (`_lane_declaring_model`, which returns `None` on `resolve_name`'s `ValueError`, crew_dispatch_commands.py:464-468) is named only in the misleading present-tense sentence.
findings.text: §17's done-when requires "a model declared by two lanes and asked for under a third ... refused by naming every lane that declares it", but this repository's catalogue declares every model key under exactly one lane (model-catalogue.yaml `lanes:` — sonnet/opus/haiku in claude, sol/astra/luna in codex, flash in clive; no key repeats), so the clause can only be exercised by constructing a fixture catalogue, which the plan does not say; the following sentence ("§14's `_lane_declaring_model` returns `None` in that case and falls back to the unknown-name message") states current behaviour inside the Done-when block and reads as an acceptance criterion rather than the gap to close
